name: Seteth
story: A Nabatean Child of the Goddess (Earth Dragon) more than 1,000 years old, bearing the Crest of Cichol. Continuity with his Three Houses appearance is unconfirmed, though the shared voice cast suggests a returning character. He is not recruitable on Dietrich's route and needs Renown 10+ on Leda's.

personalSkill.name: Ready for Battle
personalSkill.effect: For the first combat in enemy phase, unit attacks first. Trigger % = 50. Crest of Cichol (Diadem of Balance): unit cannot be countered, 3% trigger; Lv 20 gives Atk+4 on Diadem trigger, Lv 35 Atk+7.

tierNotes: KeenGamer: B tier (frontline, conditional enemy-phase first strike). Pocket Tactics: B tier.

why: Support 3 and Renown 6 tie with Theodora. Neither lord has a support with Seteth, so roster balance decided it.

build.notes: Ornius Rider on a Meganius when he joins, Armored Ornius Rider at Lv 20 (Def 65 growth) for Sense Threat, Dragoon at Lv 35 in Ch 11 or 12 (unlocked by Aurora's Renown 8 mentorship, usually Ch 10). He joins late Ch 7 (Renown 6) at about Lv 15, so Lv 35 lands late in Part I. Part II Ch 3: Guardian for Brace, which pays off on the enemy-phase kills Ready for Battle sets up. Bau Lord in Part III.

guide.summary: Ready for Battle makes him strike first in his first enemy-phase combat half the time, mounted or not. Pass Judgment (Lv 20) and Pass Judgment+ (Lv 35) add Atk +4 / +7 when his Diadem of Balance fires (3%, no counter): too rare to plan on, so the build stays Atk-first with one shield and one light item. Armored Ornius Rider on a Meganius grows Def 65 on him, and Dragoon (Ch 11 or 12) makes him your first flier.
guide.playstyle: Hold chokepoints and let foes come; once flying, cross terrain to reach casters. When the danger line shows archers can one-shot him, dismount (mounting is free).
keys: Train Flying every week from the week he joins (late Ch 7): Dragoon needs Flying C and it isn't his preferred rank.
Master Sense Threat in Armored Ornius Rider before Dragoon; it covers bows once he flies.
Do Aurora's Special Request from Mom at Renown 8 (usually Ch 10) for the Dragoon unlock. His exam is Ch 11 or 12, once he is Lv 35 with Flying C, Axe B and Spear B.
Kit: one shield (Silver Shield) plus the Gale Ring, nothing else: 6 extra weight. On archer maps, Bowbreak Amulet in the accessory slot and the shield off. No mask.
Part II Ch 3: a Guardian stint for Brace on the ground map, back to Dragoon for Ch 4.
watch: Archers on Hard can one-shot a Dragoon: Sense Threat (Avo +20 vs bows) is mandatory once he flies.
Dragoon rides a Bau, so his Ornius stays behind.
Weight: Silver Spear 6 + Silver Shield 4 + Gale Ring 2 = 12, extra 6 (enemy-phase cap); Javelin in hand 14. Archer maps: Bowbreak Amulet 4 for the ring, shield off. Doubled? Shield off first.

Inventory: 5 core (Da Mina Spear, Ji, Silver Shield, Gale Ring, Elixir), 1 open: Shielding Axe on safe maps or Bowbreak Amulet on archer maps. End of Ch 12: pack the Bowbreak Amulet, not the axe, for Part II.

guide.alt: Stay Armored Ornius Rider through Part II if Flying C lags; Nydine then becomes your only flier. Great Counter and Focused Counter were skipped: they need the foe to attack first, which Ready for Battle prevents half the time.

routeNotes.note: Ride a Meganius from his join (late Ch 7): Armored Ornius Rider grows Def 65 on it, Paired Run adds Mov, and Paired Bulk adds Bld (helps carry the Wt 7 Ji). Feed it weekly; bond 3 by Ch 10 at least.

Dragoon rides a Bau. No Part I Bau catch is confirmed, so in Part II he likely runs Dragoon's base growths (Str 50, Dex 50; Wild Bau: Str 60, Dex 60). Try Bau-Caller's Cape on the Ch 12 Stolen Star Observations trip.
Aurora's Special Request from Mom (Renown 8, Fortuna's Temple) unlocks Dragoon. Do it as soon as Renown 8 lands (usually Ch 10) so his Ch 11 or 12 exam isn't held up.
His recruit needs Renown 6 and Support 3; Kindness Quests in Ch 6 and 7 carry the Renown (usually late Ch 7).
